summary: Validated ledger all/single account period behavior on public URL with backend pytest, UI checks, and delivery gates (lint/build/installer).
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/ledger applies DB-level entry_date range filtering before row construction, which correctly enforces period-only rows for all/single modes in tested scenarios.
All-mode response contract is correct for requested scope: account_scope=all, account=null, per-row account_code/account_name present, totals equal sum(rows) within period.
server.py is very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk for accounting endpoints; modular split is recommended.
seed_data_creation: Pytest created temporary TEST-ITER66 journal entries (2099 dates) and cleaned them from Mongo in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL from frontend/.env used. Pytest passed 3/3 for ledger all/single period constraints + /api/admin/data-flow-validation + installer existence. UI automation confirmed default ledger account value is all, data-testid ledger-account-option-all exists (count=1), title shows 'دفتر الأستاذ - عرض الكل', and account column header is visible in all mode. Date filter interaction tested; run showed empty-state period (no in-range rows after cleanup). yarn lint and yarn build both passed. /app/dist/BankDepositSystemSetup.exe exists (16986678 bytes).
rca of the issue: No functional regression detected in requested scope. Initial backend test failures were test-assumption issues (hardcoded account lookup and shared-prefix row filtering), fixed at test level; application behavior remained consistent with requested ledger period logic.
